units: Offsets from the character feet pivot. Source offsets in original pixels; export offsets at 8x. Flip horizontal offsets and sprites when facing left.

cast.note: Plain Cast contains no baked spell. Spawn independent VFX at this event; their clocks run at 50ms/frame.

movement.Dust_Dash: Feet when dash starts; flip horizontally when facing left

magic.Charge_Loop: Same hand anchor; loop while charging
magic.Charge_Loop_Big: Same hand anchor; big charge loop

projectiles: Position each projectile by its own anchor; flight motion and collision are game-controlled. Spawn impacts at collision points.
